lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Plate 1 to front flange 3, ~90 deg. Sections at 25/50/75% put the label on the outer arc apex (median offset along the bisector +0.01 mm, p10/p90 -0.04/+0.06). Both flanges and the arc are present from t=1 to 267 of a 268 mm line, and the face-on close-up shows the line ends exactly at the flange ends. Flange is straight with no hem.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Plate 1 to back-left tab 6, ~90.5 deg. The arc apex sits on the label within about 0.1 mm at every station (median 0.00, p10/p90 -0.11/+0.11). The fold runs from t=-1 to 107 and the line from 0 to 106.7, so the override extent matches the tab's real ends (close-up confirmed). It is a separate tab from B3 across a full-height cutout, so a separate line is correct.

lines.label: B3
lines.reason: Plate 1 to back-right tab 9, ~90.6 deg. On the apex (median +0.01 mm). The fold runs from t=-1 to 69 and the line from 0 to 70.2, matching the tab ends in the close-up.

lines.label: B4
lines.reason: Plate 1 to upper leg 7 of the Z-joggled side flange, ~91.5 deg bend. On the outer apex (median +0.01 mm, p10/p90 -0.03/+0.05). The fold runs from t=-1 to 203 and the line from 0 to 201.4; the leg-7 extent override is correct per the face-on close-up. Thin strips 16 and 17, which sit 13 deg off leg 7, are facets on B4's own outer arc (x -1.9, y -0.5 in the B4 section), not separate bends.

lines.label: B5
lines.reason: Joggle bend 1: leg 7 to the ~8 mm step 13, ~90 deg. Wide sections clearly show the Z profile (plate, down-leg, inward step, lower leg). The label sits on the outer arc apex (median +0.01 mm). The fold runs from t=1 to 203 and the line from 0 to 203.

lines.label: B6
lines.reason: Joggle bend 2: step to lower leg 12, ~88.7 deg. The inner arc and both legs are clear in every section. The outer arc on the lower-leg side is scanned up to the apex, and the points fit a circle (R ~4.1 mm) centred on the label's bisector; median offset +0.02 mm. The outer top face of the step is mostly an unscanned pocket, so only the plane_from_points side is weakly supported, but the scanned outer-arc points confirm the label position. Strips 14 and 15 are facets of this arc. The fold runs from t=-1 to 189 and the line from 0 to 188.5, matching the lower leg's extent.
